# AllInOneImageRestoration

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-23

## Definition
A single model capable of handling multiple degradation types (e.g., noise, blur, rain) without task-specific retraining. Reduces model proliferation and memory overhead, making it suitable for resource-limited TCC/iNEST deployments.
